Know

What is Demo?

Understand what you own, what great looks like, and how to measure it.

⚠️ Needs PMM Validation
Role Card

What this area is

Demo is the practice of bringing SAP products to life through demonstrations that showcase capabilities, prove value, and connect with buyer needs. It transforms technical features into compelling stories that drive purchase decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop demo strategies and scripts
  • Create and maintain demo environments
  • Train sellers on demo delivery
  • Support high-stakes demos
  • Innovate demo formats and channels

Key deliverables

  • Demo scripts and storyboards
  • Demo environments and data
  • Demo training materials
  • Self-service demo tools
  • Demo performance analytics
Playbook
1

Demo strategy

Define demo types needed — live, recorded, self-service, interactive. Align to buyer journey stages.

2

Script development

Create demo scripts that tell stories, not feature tours. Focus on buyer problems and outcomes.

3

Environment creation

Build and maintain demo environments with realistic data and scenarios.

4

Enablement & training

Train sellers on demo delivery, customization, and recovery techniques.

5

Performance optimization

Track demo effectiveness, gather feedback, and continuously improve.

Success Metrics
Demo-to-Close Rate
Conversion from demo to closed deal
Demo Satisfaction
Buyer satisfaction scores post-demo
Self-Service Usage
Engagement with on-demand demos
Demo Freshness
% of demos updated within 90 days
